roadmap.title: Three-star the base Story
roadmap.description: Finish the tutorial, preserve order combos, three-star Worlds 1-6, trigger every map switch, and complete the campaign finale while advancing universal counters.
achievementRefs: Complete a level in recipe order
Hit all switches on the world map

roadmap.title: Clear Kevin kitchens, chefs, modes, and base counters
roadmap.description: Unlock and three-star Kevin 1-8, finish the required chef roster, complete local Arcade and Versus games, then farm only the cumulative actions still below their thresholds.
achievementRefs: Complete all hidden levels with 3 stars
Deliver each recipe in the game

roadmap.title: Complete Surf 'n' Turf
roadmap.description: Three-star all numbered and Kevin kitchens, deliver every recipe family, then use level 2-1 for Water Gun and Bellows cleanup.
achievementRefs: Deliver all individual recipes in the DLC
Clean X dirty plates or glasses with the water gun
Heat up X BBQs with the bellows

roadmap.title: Complete Campfire Cook Off
roadmap.description: Three-star all numbered and Kevin kitchens, cover every recipe family, then use the stopped-timer opening levels for firewood and backpack counters.
achievementRefs: DLC05 Burn X pieces of wood
DLC05 Take X items from backpack

roadmap.title: Complete Night of the Hangry Horde
roadmap.description: Three-star every score-rated kitchen, perfect every horde stage by repairing to full health, and finish the coal and guillotine counters with one tracked profile.
achievementRefs: DLC07 Burn X pieces of coal
DLC07 Chop X items with guillotine

roadmap.title: Complete Carnival of Chaos
roadmap.description: Three-star all numbered and Kevin kitchens, deliver every recipe family, then farm the cannon in 1-2 and condiments in 1-4.

achievements.description: Complete the main story campaign
achievements.summary: Finish the final kitchen of base-game World 6 and complete the main Story campaign.

guide.context: Only the campaign finale is required for this unlock; the three-star world and Kevin-level achievements can be cleaned up afterward on the same save.

steps.text: Earn enough stars to unlock each numbered world and advance through World 6.
Enter the final World 6 kitchen, complete every phase, and meet its completion score to finish the Story campaign.

achievements.apiName: Complete all hidden levels with 3 stars
achievements.description: Get 3 stars on all hidden levels.
achievements.summary: Unlock all @mechanic{eight base-game Kevin kitchens} and earn at least three stars on Kevin 1 through Kevin 8.

guide.context: Kevin kitchens are revealed by a specific tip combo or score on a glowing source level, with different score thresholds for solo and co-op play.

steps.text: Reveal Kevin 1 from 1-3 with a two-order combo; reveal Kevin 2 from 2-2 with a three-order solo combo or five-order co-op combo.
Reveal Kevin 3 from 2-4 with 600 solo points or 1,000 co-op points; reveal Kevin 4 from 3-1 with 450 solo points or 1,100 co-op points.
Reveal Kevin 5 from 4-3 with a four-order solo combo or five-order co-op combo; reveal Kevin 6 from 4-5 with 400 solo points or 500 co-op points.
Reveal Kevin 7 from 5-5 with a five-order solo combo or eight-order co-op combo; reveal Kevin 8 from 6-4 with a five-order solo combo or seven-order co-op combo.
Enter every revealed Kevin kitchen and raise its result to at least three stars; if co-op client credit fails, replay the missing kitchen locally or as the online host.

achievements.description: Deliver 1000 Meals
achievements.summary: Deliver @mechanic{1,000 completed meals} across Story, Arcade, Versus, and DLC kitchens.

guide.context: Meal deliveries accumulate across modes and DLC, so complete every three-star route before farming the remainder.

steps.text: Finish the base Story and all four DLC campaigns while serving valid orders.
Continue replaying a fast early kitchen and deliver correct meals until the cumulative total reaches 1,000.

achievements.description: Get 3 stars on every level in World 4
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{three stars} on every numbered level in base-game World 4.

guide.context: On kitchens that introduce a new recipe, the countdown remains stopped until the first order is served, so several dishes can be prepared before starting the timer.

steps.text: Open base-game World 4 and play each numbered kitchen shown on its map.
Prepare orders in the displayed sequence and deliver them without skips to preserve the tip multiplier.
Repeat any kitchen below the three-star score threshold, then confirm that every numbered level in the world displays at least three stars.

achievements.description: Get 3 stars on every level in World 5
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{three stars} on every numbered level in base-game World 5.

guide.context: On kitchens that introduce a new recipe, the countdown remains stopped until the first order is served, so several dishes can be prepared before starting the timer.

steps.text: Open base-game World 5 and play each numbered kitchen shown on its map.
Prepare orders in the displayed sequence and deliver them without skips to preserve the tip multiplier.
Repeat any kitchen below the three-star score threshold, then confirm that every numbered level in the world displays at least three stars.

achievements.description: Get 3 stars on every level in World 6
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{three stars} on every numbered level in base-game World 6.

guide.context: On kitchens that introduce a new recipe, the countdown remains stopped until the first order is served, so several dishes can be prepared before starting the timer.

steps.text: Open base-game World 6 and play each numbered kitchen shown on its map.

Repeat any kitchen below the three-star score threshold, then confirm that every numbered level in the world displays at least three stars.

achievements.apiName: Deliver each recipe in the game
achievements.description: Deliver every type of meal in the game
achievements.summary: Successfully deliver at least one order from every recipe family introduced in the base Story campaign.

guide.context: Each family is introduced by a tutorial kitchen and then reused in mixed-order levels, so completing Worlds 1-6 and the Kevin route normally supplies every required delivery.

steps.text: Complete every numbered Story world and serve the demonstrated recipe in each recipe-introduction kitchen.
Complete the Kevin kitchens and deliver their dumpling orders while working toward three stars.
If the achievement remains locked, replay each base recipe-introduction kitchen and serve one correct order from its newly introduced family.

achievements.apiName: Complete a level in recipe order
achievements.description: Complete a level by doing all the recipes in order
achievements.summary: Finish any kitchen while serving every completed order in the exact left-to-right queue order without skipping one.

guide.context: Sequential deliveries build a tip combo; serving a later ticket first breaks the order sequence even when the dish itself is correct.

steps.text: Choose an early kitchen with one simple recipe, such as Story 1-1.
Read the order queue from left to right and prepare the oldest ticket first.
Serve every order in queue order until time expires, then finish the kitchen to register the achievement.

achievements.description: Throw 100 ingredients into a cooking pot
achievements.summary: Throw @mechanic{100 valid ingredients} directly into cooking pots instead of placing them by hand.

guide.context: Only ingredients that land inside a pot advance this counter; ordinary countertop throws do not.

steps.text: Choose a kitchen with cooking pots and stand within throwing range of an empty or compatible pot.
Pick up an ingredient accepted by the active pot recipe and throw it so the ingredient lands inside the pot.
Repeat successful pot throws until the cumulative total reaches 100.

achievements.description: Win 10 games in versus mode
achievements.summary: Win @mechanic{10 complete Versus games} on the tracked profile; local two-side matches count.

guide.context: The winning side is determined only when the Versus timer ends, so abandonments do not count as victories.

steps.text: Create a Local Versus match with the tracked profile on one side and a second controller or player on the other.
Score more points with the tracked profile's team and let the match reach its result screen.
Repeat complete winning matches until the profile records 10 Versus victories.

achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{three stars} on every numbered level in base-game World 1.

guide.context: On kitchens that introduce a new recipe, the countdown remains stopped until the first order is served, so several dishes can be prepared before starting the timer.

steps.text: Open base-game World 1 and play each numbered kitchen shown on its map.
Prepare orders in the displayed sequence and deliver them without skips to preserve the tip multiplier.
Repeat any kitchen below the three-star score threshold, then confirm that every numbered level in the world displays at least three stars.

achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{three stars} on every numbered level in base-game World 2.

guide.context: On kitchens that introduce a new recipe, the countdown remains stopped until the first order is served, so several dishes can be prepared before starting the timer.

achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{three stars} on every numbered level in base-game World 3.

guide.context: On kitchens that introduce a new recipe, the countdown remains stopped until the first order is served, so several dishes can be prepared before starting the timer.

steps.text: Open base-game World 3 and play each numbered kitchen shown on its map.

achievements.description: Unlock all the chefs
prerequisites: Complete all hidden levels with 3 stars
achievements.summary: Unlock every required base-game chef by finishing Story through 6-5 and completing Kevin kitchens 1, 3, 5, and 7.

guide.context: The extra pig chef awarded for four-star completion is not part of this achievement; most required chefs unlock automatically from numbered Story levels.

steps.text: Finish the numbered Story route through level 6-5 to receive every chef tied to normal campaign progress.
Unlock and finish Kevin 1, Kevin 3, Kevin 5, and Kevin 7 to receive the four chefs tied to bonus kitchens.
Return to Chef Select after those four Kevin completions and confirm the base-game roster is unlocked.

achievements.displayName: If You Can't Stand the Heat
achievements.description: Extinguish a burning kitchen
achievements.summary: Let food burn until flames appear, then use the @item{Fire Extinguisher} until the kitchen fire is completely out.

guide.context: A smoking pan is not yet a kitchen fire; the ingredient must remain on the heat until visible flames spread before extinguishing can count.

steps.text: Choose a kitchen with a stove and leave a cooking ingredient in its pan or pot after the burn warning begins.
Wait for visible flames, pick up the @item{Fire Extinguisher}, aim at the burning tile, and spray until every flame disappears.

achievements.description: Complete the tutorial level
achievements.summary: Finish the opening tutorial kitchen and reach the Onion Kingdom map.

guide.context: The tutorial teaches chopping, cooking, plating, and serving before the numbered campaign worlds open.

steps.text: Start a new Story save and follow the Onion King's tutorial prompts.
Chop, cook, plate, and deliver the requested orders until the tutorial result screen appears and the campaign map opens.

achievements.description: Finish 15 Arcade games
achievements.summary: Finish @mechanic{15 Arcade games}; wins are not required and local Arcade counts.

guide.context: A game must reach its results screen to count, so quitting a kitchen early does not advance the total.

steps.text: From the main menu, choose Arcade and select Local if you want to avoid matchmaking.
Complete the full kitchen and continue through the results screen.
Finish 15 Arcade games in total, regardless of score or winning side.

achievements.description: Finish 15 versus games
achievements.summary: Finish @mechanic{15 Versus games}; wins are not required and local Versus counts.

guide.context: Local play requires at least two active sides, but the same profile can accumulate completed games without online matchmaking.

steps.text: From the main menu, choose Versus and create a Local match with a second controller or local player.
Play until the timer expires and advance through the result screen.
Finish 15 Versus games in total.

achievements.description: Throw 500 items
achievements.summary: Throw @mechanic{500 ingredients or carried items} using the throw action.

guide.context: Throws made while routing orders across counters accumulate naturally in Story and DLC kitchens.

steps.text: Use the throw action whenever moving raw ingredients across open kitchen space.
Continue throwing carried items until the cumulative counter reaches 500.

achievements.description: Catch 250 items
achievements.summary: Catch @mechanic{250 thrown items} with a second chef before the items touch a counter or floor.

guide.context: A frozen-timer tutorial kitchen allows the same two chefs to exchange ingredients without losing level time.

steps.text: Start local co-op or add a second local chef, then enter a kitchen whose timer is stopped before the first delivery.
Face the chefs toward one another, throw an ingredient from the first chef, and move the second chef into its path to catch it.
Throw the ingredient back and continue alternating catches until one profile reaches 250.

achievements.description: Put 99 items in the bin
achievements.summary: Put @mechanic{99 food items} into a kitchen bin; Story level 1-2 provides unlimited rice for a quick farm.

guide.context: Discarded food does not need to be cooked or plated, and the stopped tutorial timer in 1-2 allows uninterrupted disposal before the first order.

steps.text: Enter Story 1-2 and do not serve the first order so the timer remains stopped.
Take rice from the dispenser and place each portion directly into the bin.
Continue dispensing and binning rice until 99 discarded items have registered.

achievements.description: Wash 300 plates
achievements.summary: Completely wash @mechanic{300 dirty plates} in sinks across any kitchens.

guide.context: A plate counts after its wash cycle finishes, so merely placing dirty dishes in the sink does not advance the total.

steps.text: Carry returned dirty plates to a sink and hold the wash action until each plate becomes clean.
Repeat full wash cycles across campaign kitchens until 300 plates have been cleaned.

achievements.description: Use every emote
achievements.summary: Use all @mechanic{six kitchen emotes} during a level and all @mechanic{six lobby emotes} in a local Arcade or Versus lobby.

guide.context: The in-kitchen and lobby emote wheels contain separate sets, so clearing only one wheel leaves half of the requirement unfinished.

steps.text: Enter any kitchen, open the emote wheel, and activate each of its six emotes once.
Return to the main menu, start Local Arcade or Local Versus, and stop in the pre-game lobby.
Open the lobby emote wheel and activate each of its six emotes once.

achievements.description: Go through portals 75 times
achievements.summary: Move a chef through kitchen portals @mechanic{75 times} in total.

guide.context: Each traversal advances the counter, allowing the same paired portals to be crossed repeatedly.

steps.text: Choose any Story or DLC kitchen containing a portal pair.
Walk through either portal, return through the paired exit, and continue traversing until the counter reaches 75.

achievements.description: Chop 800 items
achievements.summary: Finish chopping @mechanic{800 ingredients} on chopping boards.

guide.context: Chops across the base game and DLC campaigns share one cumulative counter.

steps.text: Place raw chop-enabled ingredients on a chopping board and complete each chopping cycle.
Continue through campaign kitchens or replay a high-volume recipe level until 800 ingredients have been chopped.

achievements.apiName: Hit all switches on the world map
achievements.description: Hit all the switches on the world map
achievements.summary: Drive the Onion King's bus over every floor switch on the base Story map so each linked bridge or ramp rises.

guide.context: The switches are part of normal campaign traversal. If the counter fails on an old or client-created save, replay the map switches as the host on a fresh save, including the switch that opens the route to World 3.

steps.text: As each Story world opens, drive across every reachable circular floor switch before entering the next kitchen.
Confirm that each switch changes the map by raising its connected bridge or ramp, then continue until every world-map route is open.
If the achievement remains locked after the campaign, verify the game files, create a fresh host save, and activate the switches again through the switch that opens the route to World 3.

achievements.description: Get 3 stars on all Surf 'n' Turf levels
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{three stars} on every score-rated Surf 'n' Turf kitchen across Worlds 1-3 and its Kevin bonus kitchen.

guide.context: The Kevin kitchens remain hidden until their source-level score or order-combo condition is met, so finishing only the visible numbered route is not the complete three-star checklist.

steps.text: Earn three stars on every numbered kitchen in Surf 'n' Turf Worlds 1, 2, and 3.
Meet each glowing source level's solo or co-op condition to reveal its Kevin bonus kitchen, then earn three stars on every revealed Kevin kitchen.
Check the Surf 'n' Turf map for any score-rated flag below three stars and replay it until the full DLC checklist is complete.

achievements.apiName: Deliver all individual recipes in the DLC
achievements.description: Deliver every type of meal in Surf 'n' Turf
achievements.summary: Deliver at least one completed order from every recipe family introduced in Surf 'n' Turf.

guide.context: The DLC introduces its recipe families through the numbered campaign route; completing every tutorial kitchen and its later variants covers the required menu without a separate recipe-selection screen.

steps.text: Play every numbered world in Surf 'n' Turf and serve the recipe demonstrated when each new tutorial kitchen begins.
Continue through the later mixed-order kitchens and successfully deliver at least one order from every recipe family encountered.
If the achievement remains locked after the campaign, replay the Surf 'n' Turf recipe-introduction kitchens and serve one correct order of each introduced family again.

achievements.description: Get 3 stars on every level in Surf 'n' Turf World 1
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{three stars} on every numbered level in Surf 'n' Turf World 1.

guide.context: On kitchens that introduce a new recipe, the countdown remains stopped until the first order is served, so several dishes can be prepared before starting the timer.

achievements.apiName: Clean X dirty plates or glasses with the water gun
achievements.description: Wash 150 dirty plates or glasses with the water gun
achievements.summary: Use the @item{Water Gun} to wash @mechanic{150 returned dirty plates or glasses} in Surf 'n' Turf.

guide.context: Surf 'n' Turf 2-1 keeps its timer stopped before the first delivery, allowing dishes to be staged and the gun-wash loop repeated efficiently.

steps.text: Enter Surf 'n' Turf 2-1. The timer begins automatically when you serve the first order, so prepare the ingredients for the first two orders before that delivery.
Serve orders to create returned dirty plates or glasses, then aim the @item{Water Gun} at the dirty dishes and spray until they are clean.
Repeat completed Water Gun washes until the counter reaches 150.

achievements.apiName: Heat up X BBQs with the bellows
achievements.description: Use the Bellows on BBQs 500 times
achievements.summary: Apply the @item{Bellows} to Surf 'n' Turf BBQs @mechanic{500 times}.

guide.context: Surf 'n' Turf 2-1 does not start its timer before the first delivery, so Bellows inputs can be farmed without completing orders.

steps.text: Enter Surf 'n' Turf 2-1 and do not serve the first order.
Pick up the @item{Bellows}, face either BBQ, and repeatedly apply the Bellows to the grill.
Continue until 500 BBQ-heating uses have registered.

achievements.description: Get 3 stars on all Campfire Cook Off levels
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{three stars} on every score-rated Campfire Cook Off kitchen across Worlds 1-3 and its 3 Kevin bonus kitchens.

guide.context: The Kevin kitchens remain hidden until their source-level score or order-combo condition is met, so finishing only the visible numbered route is not the complete three-star checklist.

steps.text: Earn three stars on every numbered kitchen in Campfire Cook Off Worlds 1, 2, and 3.
Meet each glowing source level's solo or co-op condition to reveal its 3 Kevin bonus kitchens, then earn three stars on every revealed Kevin kitchen.
Check the Campfire Cook Off map for any score-rated flag below three stars and replay it until the full DLC checklist is complete.

achievements.description: Deliver every type of meal in Campfire Cook Off
achievements.summary: Deliver at least one completed order from every recipe family introduced in Campfire Cook Off.

guide.context: The DLC introduces its recipe families through the numbered campaign route; completing every tutorial kitchen and its later variants covers the required menu without a separate recipe-selection screen.

steps.text: Play every numbered world in Campfire Cook Off and serve the recipe demonstrated when each new tutorial kitchen begins.
Continue through the later mixed-order kitchens and successfully deliver at least one order from every recipe family encountered.
If the achievement remains locked after the campaign, replay the Campfire Cook Off recipe-introduction kitchens and serve one correct order of each introduced family again.

achievements.apiName: DLC05 Burn X pieces of wood
achievements.description: Burn 300 pieces of wood
achievements.summary: Chop and burn @mechanic{300 pieces of firewood} in Campfire Cook Off ovens.

guide.context: Campfire Cook Off 1-1 keeps the timer stopped before the first order, and two chefs can split chopping and furnace-loading work.

steps.text: Enter Campfire Cook Off 1-1 and do not deliver the first order.
Take a log, chop it completely on a board, and place the chopped wood into the campfire oven.
Keep chopping and loading wood until 300 pieces have burned and the achievement registers.

achievements.apiName: DLC05 Take X items from backpack
achievements.description: Take 500 items from a backpack
achievements.summary: Use one chef to remove @mechanic{500 ingredients} from another chef's backpack in Campfire Cook Off.

guide.context: Campfire Cook Off 1-3 has a stopped opening timer and backpacks; positioning the receiving chef beside the carrier prevents each extracted item from blocking the interaction.

steps.text: Enter Campfire Cook Off 1-3 with two local chefs and do not serve the first order.
Keep one chef wearing a backpack while the tracked chef stands beside the carrier and removes an ingredient.
Throw each extracted ingredient aside immediately, then keep removing replacements until the tracked chef reaches 500 backpack takes.

achievements.description: Survive all horde stages in Night of the Hangry Horde with full kitchen health
achievements.summary: Finish every Night of the Hangry Horde horde kitchen with @mechanic{full kitchen health} remaining.

guide.context: Serving an enemy removes it without barrier damage, while delaying one low-damage Unbread lets the team prepare the next wave and spend coins repairing every damaged passage.

steps.text: Enter each horde kitchen and serve the requested dishes to every enemy except the final low-damage Unbread of a wave.
Prepare that last enemy's dish but leave it unserved while staging ingredients for the next wave and repairing every damaged barrier to full health.
Serve the held dish, repeat the delay-and-repair cycle for later waves, and finish the stage only when the kitchen-health display is completely full.
Repeat a perfect clear on every horde kitchen in the DLC.

achievements.description: Get 3 stars on all Night of the Hangry Horde levels with a star rating
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{three stars} on every score-rated Night of the Hangry Horde kitchen across Worlds 1-3 and its 3 Kevin bonus kitchens.

steps.text: Earn three stars on every numbered kitchen in Night of the Hangry Horde Worlds 1, 2, and 3.
Meet each glowing source level's solo or co-op condition to reveal its 3 Kevin bonus kitchens, then earn three stars on every revealed Kevin kitchen.
Check the Night of the Hangry Horde map for any score-rated flag below three stars and replay it until the full DLC checklist is complete.

achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{three stars} on every numbered level in Night of the Hangry Horde World 1.

achievements.apiName: DLC07 Burn X pieces of coal
achievements.description: Burn 300 buckets of coal in the furnace
achievements.summary: Have one tracked chef place @mechanic{300 buckets of coal} into Night of the Hangry Horde furnaces.

guide.context: Co-op coal inputs are profile-specific, and the frozen-timer 1-2 farm has failed to track for some players; a timed furnace kitchen is slower but safer for progress.

steps.text: Choose a timed Night of the Hangry Horde kitchen containing a furnace and assign one chef profile to all coal loading.
Collect a coal bucket and place it into the furnace whenever fuel is available.
Continue loading coal with the same tracked chef across completed sessions until that profile reaches 300 buckets.

achievements.apiName: DLC07 Chop X items with guillotine
achievements.description: Chop 500 ingredients using the guillotine
achievements.summary: Use the Night of the Hangry Horde @item{Guillotine} to chop @mechanic{500 ingredients}.

guide.context: World 1-1 keeps the opening timer stopped, allowing chopped ingredients to be thrown aside as the guillotine counter is farmed.

steps.text: Enter Night of the Hangry Horde 1-1 and do not serve the first order.
Throw a valid ingredient onto the @item{Guillotine}, activate the blade until the ingredient is chopped, and clear the result to either side.
Repeat complete guillotine chops until the counter reaches 500.

achievements.description: Get 3 stars on all Carnival of Chaos levels
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{three stars} on every score-rated Carnival of Chaos kitchen across Worlds 1-3 and its 3 Kevin bonus kitchens.

guide.context: The Kevin kitchens remain hidden until their source-level score or order-combo condition is met, so finishing only the visible numbered route is not the complete three-star checklist.

steps.text: Earn three stars on every numbered kitchen in Carnival of Chaos Worlds 1, 2, and 3.
Meet each glowing source level's solo or co-op condition to reveal its 3 Kevin bonus kitchens, then earn three stars on every revealed Kevin kitchen.
Check the Carnival of Chaos map for any score-rated flag below three stars and replay it until the full DLC checklist is complete.

achievements.description: Deliver every type of meal in Carnival of Chaos
achievements.summary: Deliver at least one completed order from every recipe family introduced in Carnival of Chaos.

guide.context: The DLC introduces its recipe families through the numbered campaign route; completing every tutorial kitchen and its later variants covers the required menu without a separate recipe-selection screen.

steps.text: Play every numbered world in Carnival of Chaos and serve the recipe demonstrated when each new tutorial kitchen begins.
Continue through the later mixed-order kitchens and successfully deliver at least one order from every recipe family encountered.
If the achievement remains locked after the campaign, replay the Carnival of Chaos recipe-introduction kitchens and serve one correct order of each introduced family again.

achievements.description: Get 3 stars on every level in Carnival of Chaos World 1
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{three stars} on every numbered level in Carnival of Chaos World 1.

guide.context: On kitchens that introduce a new recipe, the countdown remains stopped until the first order is served, so several dishes can be prepared before starting the timer.

steps.text: Open Carnival of Chaos World 1 and play each numbered kitchen shown on its map.
Prepare orders in the displayed sequence and deliver them without skips to preserve the tip multiplier.
Repeat any kitchen below the three-star score threshold, then confirm that every numbered level in the world displays at least three stars.

achievements.description: Fire a Chef from a Cannon 100 times
achievements.summary: Launch a chef from Carnival of Chaos cannons @mechanic{100 times}.

guide.context: Carnival of Chaos 1-2 keeps the timer stopped before the first delivery, so the same chef and cannon can be reused continuously.

steps.text: Enter Carnival of Chaos 1-2 and do not serve the first order.
Move a chef into a cannon, aim at a safe landing tile, and fire the chef.
Return to the cannon and repeat the complete launch until 100 chef firings have registered.

achievements.description: Add mustard or ketchup to a recipe 100 times
achievements.summary: Apply @item{Mustard} or @item{Ketchup} to recipes @mechanic{100 times} in Carnival of Chaos.

guide.context: Carnival of Chaos 1-4 has a stopped opening timer and accepts condiment applications on assembled hot dogs, including repeated applications to the same valid recipe.

steps.text: Enter Carnival of Chaos 1-4 and do not serve the first order.
Cook a sausage, place it in a bun, and leave the assembled hot dog unserved.
Use the Mustard or Ketchup dispenser on the valid hot dog repeatedly until 100 condiment applications have registered.
